<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Lotus / Meditation Symbol: stilisierter sitzender Mensch mit Aura-Kreis --> <vector xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" android:width="24dp" android:height="24dp" android:viewportWidth="24" android:viewportHeight="24">
<!-- Äußerer Kreis (Aura) --> <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="1.5" android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M12,2 A10,10 0 1,1 11.99,2 Z" />
<!-- Kopf --> <path android:fillColor="#FFFFFF" android:pathData="M12,5.5 A1.5,1.5 0 1,1 11.99,5.5 Z" />
<!-- Körper: sitzende Position --> <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="1.5" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M12,8.5 L12,13" />
<!-- Linker Arm / Bein --> <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="1.5" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M12,13 L8,15.5" />
<!-- Rechter Arm / Bein --> <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="1.5" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M12,13 L16,15.5" />
<!-- Verbindungslinie Beine (Lotus-Sitz) --> <path android:strokeColor="#FFFFFF" android:strokeWidth="1.5" android:strokeLineCap="round" android:fillColor="#00000000" android:pathData="M7,16.5 L17,16.5" />
<!-- Linke Hand (ruht auf Knie) --> <path android:fillColor="#FFFFFF" android:pathData="M7.5,16 A0.8,0.8 0 1,1 7.49,16 Z" />
<!-- Rechte Hand (ruht auf Knie) --> <path android:fillColor="#FFFFFF" android:pathData="M16.5,16 A0.8,0.8 0 1,1 16.49,16 Z" />
</vector>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?> <!-- Root FrameLayout erlaubt das vollflächige Overlay über dem gesamten Inhalt --> <FrameLayout xmlns:android="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res/android" xmlns:app="http://schemas.android.com/apk/res-auto" xmlns:tools="http://schemas.android.com/tools" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="@color/dark_background" tools:context=".MainActivity">
<!-- ===== Haupt-Inhalt ===== --> <androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:padding="12dp">
<!-- ===== Titelzeile mit Settings-Button ===== --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvAppTitle" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/app_name" android:textSize="22sp" android:textColor="@color/purple_200" android:textStyle="bold" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toStartOf="@id/btnSettings" />
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnSettings" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_settings" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="@string/settings" android:scaleType="fitCenter" app:layout_constraintTop_toTopOf="@id/tvAppTitle" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="@id/tvAppTitle" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />
<!-- ===== Now Playing Card (Album Art + Controls nebeneinander) ===== --> <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/cardNowPlaying" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="10dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/surface" app:cardCornerRadius="12dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvAppTitle" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:padding="12dp" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<!-- Album Art – anklickbar für Vollbild --> <ImageView android:id="@+id/ivAlbumArt" android:layout_width="80dp" android:layout_height="80dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_album_placeholder" android:scaleType="centerCrop" android:contentDescription="@string/album_art_desc" android:background="@drawable/album_art_bg" android:clickable="true" android:focusable="true" android:foreground="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" />
<!-- Rechte Seite: Track-Info + Controls --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:orientation="vertical" android:layout_marginStart="12dp">
<!-- Track name --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackName" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/no_track" android:textSize="15sp" android:textColor="@color/white" android:textStyle="bold" android:ellipsize="marquee" android:singleLine="true" android:marqueeRepeatLimit="marquee_forever" android:focusable="true" android:focusableInTouchMode="true" />
<!-- Track artist --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackArtist" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#B0FFFFFF" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" android:ellipsize="end" android:singleLine="true" tools:text="Künstler" />
<!-- Fortschrittsbalken + Zeitanzeige --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginTop="4dp">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvCurrentPosition" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="10sp" android:textColor="#80FFFFFF" android:text="0:00" android:minWidth="28dp" />
<SeekBar android:id="@+id/seekProgress" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:max="1000" android:progress="0" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" android:layout_marginEnd="4dp" android:thumb="@null" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackDurationLabel" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="10sp" android:textColor="#80FFFFFF" android:text="0:00" android:minWidth="28dp" android:gravity="end" /> </LinearLayout>
<!-- Play + Skip + Random Switch in einer Zeile --> <LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:layout_marginTop="6dp">
<!-- Zurück an Titelanfang --> <ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnRestartTrack" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_skip_previous" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="@string/restart_track" android:scaleType="fitCenter" />
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnPlayPause" android:layout_width="48dp" android:layout_height="48dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_play" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="@string/play" android:scaleType="fitCenter" />
<ImageButton android:id="@+id/btnSkip" android:layout_width="40dp" android:layout_height="40dp" android:src="@drawable/ic_skip_next" android:background="?attr/selectableItemBackgroundBorderless" android:contentDescription="@string/next_track" android:scaleType="fitCenter" android:layout_marginStart="4dp" />
<!-- Spacer --> <View android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="1dp" android:layout_weight="1" />
<!-- Random Switch --> <com.google.android.material.materialswitch.MaterialSwitch android:id="@+id/switchRandom" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:checked="true" android:contentDescription="@string/random_mode" /> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> </LinearLayout> </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
<!-- ===== Lautstärke Card ===== --> <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/cardVolume" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/surface" app:cardCornerRadius="12dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/cardNowPlaying" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="vertical" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp" android:paddingTop="8dp" android:paddingBottom="8dp">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical">
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvVolumeLabel" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_weight="1" android:text="@string/volume" android:textSize="13sp" android:textColor="@color/teal_200" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvVolumePercent" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#80FFFFFF" tools:text="15%" /> </LinearLayout>
<SeekBar android:id="@+id/seekVolume" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:max="200" android:progress="30" android:layout_marginTop="2dp" /> </LinearLayout> </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
<!-- ===== Timer Card (kompakt, alles in einer Zeile) ===== --> <com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView android:id="@+id/cardTimer" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" app:cardBackgroundColor="@color/surface" app:cardCornerRadius="12dp" app:cardElevation="4dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/cardVolume" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent">
<LinearLayout android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:orientation="horizontal" android:gravity="center_vertical" android:paddingStart="12dp" android:paddingEnd="12dp" android:paddingTop="6dp" android:paddingBottom="6dp">
<TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/sleep_timer" android:textSize="13sp" android:textColor="@color/teal_200" android:layout_marginEnd="8dp" />
<Spinner android:id="@+id/spinnerTimer" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="42dp" android:layout_weight="1" />
<TextView android:id="@+id/tvTimerRemaining" android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:text="@string/timer_off" android:textSize="13sp" android:textColor="@color/white" android:layout_marginStart="10dp" /> </LinearLayout> </com.google.android.material.card.MaterialCardView>
<!-- ===== Track-Anzahl ===== --> <TextView android:id="@+id/tvTrackCount" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_marginTop="8dp" android:textSize="12sp" android:textColor="#80FFFFFF" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/cardTimer" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" tools:text="42 Titel gefunden" />
<!-- ===== Track-Liste (füllt restlichen Platz) ===== --> <androidx.recyclerview.widget.RecyclerView android:id="@+id/recyclerTracks" android:layout_width="0dp" android:layout_height="0dp" android:layout_marginTop="4dp" app:layout_constraintTop_toBottomOf="@id/tvTrackCount" app:layout_constraintBottom_toBottomOf="parent" app:layout_constraintStart_toStartOf="parent" app:layout_constraintEnd_toEndOf="parent" />
</androidx.constraintlayout.widget.ConstraintLayout>
<!-- ===== Vollbild-Overlay für Album Art (über allem, initial unsichtbar) ===== --> <FrameLayout android:id="@+id/overlayAlbumArt" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:background="#DD000000" android:visibility="gone" android:clickable="true" android:focusable="true">
<ImageView android:id="@+id/ivAlbumArtFull" android:layout_width="match_parent" android:layout_height="match_parent" android:scaleType="fitCenter" android:padding="32dp" android:contentDescription="@string/album_art_desc" />
<!-- Schließen-Hinweis --> <TextView android:layout_width="wrap_content" android:layout_height="wrap_content" android:layout_gravity="bottom|center_horizontal" android:layout_marginBottom="32dp" android:text="Antippen zum Schließen" android:textColor="#80FFFFFF" android:textSize="13sp" />
</FrameLayout>
</FrameLayout>
